name: kenwea-notary
displayName: Kenwea Notary: npm install steps, traced
description: Shows above each dependency in package.json what it runs at install and whether that reached for the network, from a signed record verified on your machine. Also gives agents the Kenwea notary MCP server.

commands.title: Check every dependency in this package.json that runs something at install

kenwea.lookUpOnOpen.description: When a package.json opens, read from the npm registry what each dependency declares to run at install. Nothing is sent to Kenwea for this.

kenwea.checkAutomatically.description: Send the dependencies that run something at install to the Kenwea notary without asking. Only their names and versions are sent.

kenwea.maxAutomaticChecks.description: At most this many automatic notary checks each time a package.json is opened or saved. The notary allows 20 checks per hour per network address.
